## Purpose
`/ontology/libraries/$libraryId`: one library's knowledge-graph workspace (documents, extraction, its ontology and domains). The open half is kept in the URL.

## Responsibilities
`OntologyLibraryPage` reads `ragApi.overview` (usually already cached from the card grid), finds the library, and renders `components/ontology/LibraryDetail`. Titled "Library — Ontology — Agentic AI Design Patterns".

## Key elements
`OntologyLibraryPage`.

## Control flow
React Query.

## Data, state and side effects
None.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- **Backend:** `/api/rag/*`.

## Error handling and edge cases
- EmptyState when the library is not found.

## Nuances and gotchas
`ontology_` is non-nested, so this page does not render inside the Catalog hub.

## How to rebuild this file
As described.

None.
